results=[]
for song_id in target_song_ids:
    print('--- song_id', song_id)

        page=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=song_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('  page_index', page_index, 'len', len(page))
        if not page:

        print('   user_review_id', r.get('song_review_id'), 'rating', r.get('rating'))
    # assume at most one user review; if multiple, pick the latest by created_at lexicographic
    if user_reviews:
        # choose max created_at
        chosen=sorted(user_reviews, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at') or '', reverse=True)[0]
    else:
        chosen=None
    results.append({'song_id': song_id, 'existing_user_review': chosen})

print('done; summary:')

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [Problem Solving Heuristics And Workflows: When a task requires performing an action on a SUBSET... create an explicit filtered list as an intermediate artifact]</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Verifying updated ratings for the selected intersection songs for the current user.</uncertainty>')

target_song_ids=[40,159,175,211,239,249,254]
user_email='as_moore@gmail.com'

verification=[]
for song_id in target_song_ids:
    page_index=0
    all_reviews=[]
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=song_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    user_reviews=[r for r in all_reviews if (r.get('user',{}) or {}).get('email')==user_email]
    # choose latest
    chosen=None
    if user_reviews:
        chosen=sorted(user_reviews, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at') or '', reverse=True)[0]
    rating=chosen.get('rating') if chosen else None
    verification.append((song_id, chosen.get('song_review_id') if chosen else None, rating))

print('verification_results', verification)

# final assertion: all ratings should be 5
all_five=all(r[2]==5 or r[2]==5.0 for r in verification)
print('all_five', all_five)
